rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for lacking interest in a subject, activity, or programme.

example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 mou5 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this for a person who is emotionally indifferent or shows little concern, rather than simply finding something boring.

example.english: They are uninterested in other people.
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 hou2 laang5 mok6
